question: Which of the following has developed world's first malaria vaccine for the World Health Organization?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GlaxoSmithKline(GSK)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **GlaxoSmithKline(GSK)** has developed the world's first malaria vaccine for the World Health Organization.
 
• The vaccine, known as **RTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S)**, is the first and, to date, the only vaccine that has demonstrated it can significantly reduce malaria in children.
